must_cover: This matches dinner table syndrome (Hall et al 2018), the exclusion of a deaf child from ambient family conversation

The concrete fix is family members building enough signing fluency to include the child directly in everyday conversation, not just formal instruction time
must_not: Dismissing the behavior as normal quiet-kid temperament with no follow-up
